author: SirSharris
body:
Hi, i was banned for "Advertising" on the server on June 15 2014, it's been a year now, and i'm really sorry for my horrible actions, The reason i did it in the first place is, I tried to join a Nublua minigame (sorry for my terrible spelling) and it was full so what i did is i told someone to join my server (that doesn't even exist) so they could leave the game and i could join again, i'm really sorry for this and i hope i can be able to join the server again, I really love the server minigames and iv'e missed it for over a year now D: i hope you can forgive me and let me play on the server again

Your sincerely
SamHarris
